implementation.records: Overview and maintenance use bounded record metadata batches (at most 500 IDs) and synthetic-owner checks over preloaded current-account departments. The original global visible-record list now shares identity/leadership reads only within its invocation; source encounter order is retained. All use the original row matcher, including stored record year and draft owner/server capability checks.
implementation.core: Overview archive query projects only indicator/report IDs, frozen name/target/value and month. Keeps original mapping join, cutoff and month/archive-time/report-ID ordering. Indicator access checks use bounded ID batches rather than per-row queries.
implementation.frontend: Six module reads are scheduled with at most two in flight; same-generation duplicate reads share a promise, queued stale reads are skipped and active reads abort on year/month changes or unmount. A slow module does not block ready sections. Same-period refresh errors retain and explicitly mark old results. Year/month/account changes clear old context; permission denials clear corresponding data or all cards and the drawer.
implementation.error_metadata: Common request errors retain Error type/messages/auth redirects and add responseCode. Summary keeps legacy error shape and adds accessDenied=true for caught module scope denials so denied values are not treated as stale data.
implementation.test_harness: Named run directories and configurable frontend/backend ports avoid existing local services. Occupied ports fail before fixture creation; tests can select an independent state file and results directory.

record_scope_measurements.method: Random isolated synthetic database; 120/600 submitted records, same read-only REPEATABLE_READ transaction wrapper for original individual canRead checks and the new batch. Common request permission state initialized outside timing. One warm-up discarded and median of five sequential samples. IDs equal. Metadata/scope phase only, not page latency, P95, concurrent users or full-system acceptance.

current_backend_loading_comparison.method: One synthetic administrator, current optimized backend, sequential paired runs, one warm-up discarded and median of five samples. API response timings only, not browser rendering, cold start, multi-account concurrency or full-system P95.

loading_tradeoff: On this small current-backend fixture, progressive loading produced an earlier first API response but increased full-set API duration and transferred bytes: six reads replace one combined call. It improves independent rendering under slow modules; it is not an unconditional whole-page latency win. The combined endpoint remains compatible. Multi-account/load acceptance is still required.

scope_query_evidence.owner_checks: No per-owner metadata query; current-owner fields are supplied by the existing eligible-author result.
scope_query_evidence.limits: Query-count assertions use mocks, not a live SQL profiler.

compatibility_cases: Records: actual stored year overrides caller year; ALL/year-limited/OWN/BUSINESS/CUSTOM/LEADERSHIP scopes equal original checks
Deleted records absent; own drafts preserved; other drafts require current server-validated capability even for administrators
Owner counter keeps original synthetic object ID zero semantics; record list encounter order retained
Old Token after permission/scope/duty changes and stopped account remains checked against current database state
Core: cutoff excludes future/obsolete results, frozen name/target preserved, duplicate mapping warning and current ID scope preserved
Budget-year scope denial keeps status=error while distinguishing denied data for frontend clearing
Slow old year, failed first load, stale refresh retry, denied scope, account change mid-read, drawer close and narrow viewport
Existing filters, counts, paging, core, expert, budget and work-record flows unchanged
remaining: Task/performance/achievement/audit/message list projection and SQL pagination work remains partial.
Scoped summaries and record metadata enumeration still materialize their original source sets; no full-system aggregation or data cache was introduced.
Sustained multi-account 1/10/30-user and 5x-scale end-to-end P50/P95 acceptance, scan-row tracing and index acceptance remain unfinished.
deployment: No update package or online deployment. When authorized, deploy backend before the matching frontend so module accessDenied metadata is available. Restore matching previous artifacts to roll back; no schema migration or business-data rollback is needed.
